P2, P3 and P4 do pass through what the paper leaves open (a fragile whole, the Level-5 confidence floor of Debt 26, measurement per node), but none of them carries the road past the brake without P1. The road rests on a premise the paper rules out, and fires nothing. The AI's own break of the road to everyone, where nothing is left to protect, is sound.
